findings.current: With neither time nor room to dodge, he had no choice left.
findings.defect: “Room to dodge” adds a physical-space constraint. The Korean says there was no time to evade and that evasion was impossible; it does not specify lack of room.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly gives two constraints: no time to evade and no ability to evade. The replacement preserves both without adding a spatial detail.
findings.replacement: With no time to dodge—and no way he could do so—he had no choice left.
findings.source: Korean source lines 121–123; assembled English P61

summary: One minor action-detail shift: the source says he had neither time nor the ability to evade, not that he lacked physical room.
